text:
Type: flatweave plaid runner rug
Use: covering a long narrow floor; hallway, bedroom, entryway
Style: farmhouse, traditional, rustic
Materials: flatwoven fabric, heathered texture
Colors: warm grey, ivory, red stripes, olive accents
Shape: long narrow runner, large tartan plaid with thin red and olive lines, thin flat weave, clean bound edges
Feel: cozy, homey, casual
Goes with: warm wood, navy cabinetry, herringbone floors; farmhouse or cottage rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Casual Plaid Runner Rug, 2' 6" x 8', Flatweave, Grey, Ivory, Red
product.description: Large plaid squares with red accents bring casual warmth to a modern or farmhouse decor. This handwoven rug will bring dimension to a hallway or entryway. PET fiber, created from recycled plastic, makes it easy to maintain. 2' 6" x 8' Low pile is easy to maintain. Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
